name: notes-game-react
description: Online multiplayer card game written in ReactJS and NodeJS

scripts.setup: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd lib/db && node create
scripts.copyshared: copyfiles shared/Shared.ts client/src && copyfiles shared/Shared.ts server/src && copyfiles shared/Shared.ts ai
scripts.local: npm run copyshared && cd client && npm run build && copyfiles -u 1 "build/**/*" ../server/src/public && cd ../server && npm run local
scripts.dev: npm run copyshared && cd client && npm run dev && cd ../server && npm run dev
scripts.prod: npm run copyshared && cd client && npm run build && copyfiles -u 1 "build/**/*" ../server/src/public && cd ../server && npm run prod
scripts.e2e: npm run copyshared && cd client && npm run build && copyfiles -u 1 "build/**/*" ../server/src/public && cd .. && cd server && npm run create-database && cd .. && npx kill-port 3001 && concurrently -k -n server,ai "cd server && npm run local" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3001 -t 30000 && npx open-cli http://localhost:3001 && cd ai && npm run setup && node ../scripts/e2e-ai.js"

author: mpallansch@adittech.com
